Schools

PMS musical Frozen JR. coming October 23-25

By Amy Moorhead · October 7, 2026 · 1 min read

Piedmont Middle School presents Frozen JR. October 23-25, based on the 2018 Broadway musical. The show features all of the memorable songs from the animated film, with music and lyrics by Kristen Anderson-Lopez and Robert Lopez, plus five new songs written for the Broadway production.

A story of true love and acceptance between sisters, Frozen JR. expands upon the emotional relationship and journey between Princesses Anna and Elsa. When faced with danger, the two discover their hidden potential and the powerful bond of sisterhood. With a cast of beloved characters and loaded with magic, adventure, and plenty of humor, Frozen JR. is sure to thaw even the coldest heart.

Frozen JR. runs approximately 75 minutes, which includes intermission, and is appropriate for the entire family. Performances are Friday October 23, 7:00 p.m., Saturday, October 24, 2:00 p.m. & 7:00 p.m., and Sunday, October 25, 2:00 p.m. All performances are at the Alan Harvey Theater. Tickets are available for purchase online at https://phsmusicalsdance.ludus.com/index.php
